senses.gloss: गौरी- + ईश गौरी- + ईश, m. a name of Śiva, MBh. 14, 210.
गौरी- + गुरु गौरी- + गुरु, m. a name of the Himālaya, Śāk. d. 144.

गौर गौर,
 I. adj., f. री, White, yellow, pale red, Megh. 53; Rām. 5, 14, 30.
 II. m.
 1. A kind of buffalo, Bos gaurus, Bhāg. P. 3, 10, 21.
 2. White mustard, as a measure, Yājñ. 1, 362.
 III. f. री,
 1. Turmeric, Suśr. 1, 59, 11.
 2. A young girl prior to menstruation, Pañc. iii. d. 213.
 3. The wife of Śiva, Megh. 51.
 4. The wife of Varuṇa, MBh. 5, 3968.
 5. The name of a river, MBh. 6, 333.
 IV. n. Saffron, Caur. 10.

गौरव गौरव, i. e. गुरु + अ,
 I. adj. Relating to the spiritual teacher, Bhāg. P. 1, 7, 46.
 II. n.
 1. Heaviness, Rām. 3, 4, 26.
 2. Importance, Rām. 4, 16, 47.
 3. Dignity, Man. 2, 145.
 4. Respect, Pañc. 265, 4.
 --Comp.
गौरिक गौरिक, i. e. गौर + इक, m. White mustard (?), Suśr. 2, 119, 6.
गौरी- + नाथ गौरी- + नाथ, m. a name of Śiva, Bhartṛ. 3, 87.
गौरी- + पति गौरी- + पति, m. a name of Śiva, Kathās. 22, 16.
गौर- + मृग गौर- + मृग, m. a kind of buffalo, Bos gaurus, Bhāg. P. 8, 10, 9.
गौरी- + व्रत गौरी- + व्रत, n. lasciviousness, Hit. 42, 2.
गौर- + सर्षप गौर- + सर्षप, m. 1. white mustard, Sinapis glauca, Man. 5, 120; Suśr. 1, 16, 10. 2. a measure of weight, Man. 8, 133.
